annotations.title: Attach this session to its line (take the lease)

description: Plug this session (a cable = a model) into the line of its key and get the identity package: line, lease and epoch, persona with voice, wiring, memory brief (last handover, last messages per account), state and events cursor. A free line or a lease expired 10 minutes after its last renewal is taken with epoch + 1; attaching again with the same cable renews it. A live lease of another cable is switched only by the owner. Writing as the line renews the lease too.

model.description: The model this session runs (declared, e.g. claude-opus-4-5). Send null to remove an earlier declaration.

runs_on.description: Machine the session runs on, e.g. hp, lenovo, vps-1.

name: line_attach
